text.arabic_uthmani: ۞ جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْكَعْبَةَ ٱلْبَيْتَ ٱلْحَرَامَ قِيَٰمًۭا لِّلنَّاسِ وَٱلشَّهْرَ ٱلْحَرَامَ وَٱلْهَدْىَ وَٱلْقَلَٰٓئِدَ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِتَعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ

words.gloss_range: appointing or rendering within a double-object clause
words.root_gloss_range: making, appointing, rendering, and arranging; local force is institutional assignment, not origination from nothing

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: appointing or rendering within a double-object clause

words.prose: The opening {{ar:جَعَلَ}} ({{tr:jaʿala}}) makes the ayah begin with divine appointment: the sacred list is rendered a support-system before its purpose is explained. The double-object frame keeps the sense on institutional assignment rather than creation from nothing, and the same verb register shifts from legal relief in 5:6 to founding force here.

topics.headline: constitutive assignment, not bare creation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening verb installs a public function for the sanctuary system instead of merely reporting that objects exist.
topics.reason: The double-object grammar and resultant support noun keep the local sense on appointing or rendering; rows that contrast creation are preserved as a scope limit.

topics.headline: same-surah register shift
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the same making-register move from legal relief in 5:6 to institutional founding in 5:97.
topics.reason: The cross-reference has a concrete same-surah contrast and is compatible with the local verb frame.

words.gloss_range: the named divine agent of the opening act
words.root_gloss_range: divinity and worship; locally the proper divine name functioning as grammatical subject

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the named divine agent of the opening act

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهُ}} ({{tr:allāhu}}) is the grammatical agent of the whole arrangement, so the sacred markers are not autonomous customs. The name’s divinity and devotion/turning associations intensify that agency; the repeated divine name ties the opening act to the later knowledge clauses, and the list protected in 5:2 is now explained as purposeful.

topics.headline: named divine agency frames the ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sacred markers are grounded in the named divine agent, with divinity and devotion/turning associations intensifying the agency that reappears in the knowledge clauses.
topics.reason: The nominative subject role and threefold name recurrence support this framing.

topics.headline: earlier marker list explained
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes that the protected-marker list from 5:2 is repeated here with its purpose disclosed.
topics.reason: The row gives a concrete same-surah list parallel, and the local list matches it.

words.gloss_range: the recognized sanctuary named as the first object
words.root_gloss_range: cube, protrusion, and joint-like support associations; locally the named sanctuary, not a generic shape

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the recognized sanctuary named as the first object

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكَعْبَةَ}} ({{tr:al-kaʿbata}}) names the recognized sanctuary as the first object before the title that follows interprets it. Its cube, ankle-bone, and protrusion field makes the sanctuary feel like a bodily and geometric standing-point within the support system, while the local sense remains the named sanctuary; its rare same-surah pairing with 5:95 gives the name concentrated force.

topics.headline: specific sanctuary named first
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the recognized sanctuary named before its title, making it the first concrete component of the support system.
topics.reason: Definiteness, accusative object role, and apposition in the following words support the local specificity.

topics.headline: cube and joint imagery narrowed to support pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the cube, ankle-bone, and protrusion field making the sanctuary feel like a concrete standing-point, while the local sense remains the named sanctuary itself.
topics.reason: The root field supports geometric and bodily associations, but the local grammar does not license making a metaphysical joint the lexical sense.

topics.headline: rare same-surah naming
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this explicit sanctuary name is rare and concentrated with 5:95, where destination and institution define each other.
topics.reason: The distribution row is concrete and reinforces the local Surah 5 pilgrimage-law context.

words.gloss_range: the House as appositional title for the sanctuary
words.root_gloss_range: dwelling, shelter, night-settlement, and house; locally the known Sacred House

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the House as appositional title for the sanctuary

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْبَيْتَ}} ({{tr:al-bayta}}) is appositional, so the Kaaba is being identified as the known House rather than joined by another list item. The house/shelter field makes the public support feel like settled protection, and 2:125 gives a parallel House-for-people appointment where return and security are the stated functions.

topics.headline: known House title locks onto the sanctuary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees that the House is not another list item but an appositional title interpreting the named sanctuary.
topics.reason: QAC grammar identifies apposition, and the sequence moves from name to title to sacred qualifier.

topics.headline: shelter and settlement pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels public support described with the warmth of dwelling, shelter, and settled orientation.
topics.reason: The root range is locally compatible with the House title and the support predicate.

topics.headline: House-for-people formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears 5:97 alongside 2:125, where the House is also made for people, with return and security there set beside support here.
topics.reason: The concrete 2:125 parallel shares the making verb, House, people-beneficiary phrase, and functional predicate.

words.gloss_range: inviolable sacredness qualifying the House
words.root_gloss_range: prohibition, sacrality, protected boundary, and deprivation; locally sacred inviolability

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: inviolable sacredness qualifying the House

words.prose: The first {{ar:ٱلْحَرَامَ}} ({{tr:al-ḥarāma}}) qualifies the House as inviolable sacred space. Its prohibition-and-sacrality range makes the boundary itself part of the support, and the repeated adjective will carry that same force from place into time.

topics.headline: inviolable House qualification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that inviolability is an identifying property of the House, not an optional mood around it.
topics.reason: The adjective agrees with the House apposition and restricts the local object to sacred space.

topics.headline: prohibition creates protected sacred space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees sacredness and prohibition working together: the House supports people precisely as a protected boundary.
topics.reason: The root range permits sacred and forbidden valences, and both fit the modifier of the House.

topics.headline: sacrality carried toward time
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same sacred-boundary word will be carried from place into month, linking space and time.
topics.reason: The later occurrence in the ayah supplies the domain shift without changing the local modifier force.

words.gloss_range: support, standing, and sustaining function produced by the opening verb
words.root_gloss_range: standing, rising, maintaining, and sustaining; local noun names the support-function of the listed institutions

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: support, standing, and sustaining function produced by the opening verb

words.prose: {{ar:قِيَٰمًۭا}} ({{tr:qiyāman}}) is the produced support-function of the whole sacred list. Standing, maintenance, and social stability remain vivid, with 4:5 showing the same support idea in a material setting; variant readings widen the support spectrum without displacing the local form. The support-for-people phrase also works audibly, with nasal cadence binding the support noun to its human beneficiaries before the close expands into divine knowledge.

topics.headline: resultant support-function
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees support as the produced state of the whole list, whether parsed as second object or state.
topics.reason: The accusative relation to the opening verb makes the support-function central to the clause.

topics.headline: standing and sustaining social support
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sanctuary complex is pictured as something that keeps human society upright, with 4:5 as a material-support parallel.
topics.reason: The root range and the 4:5 parallel support a social-stability reading within the local predicate.

topics.headline: variant support spectrum
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a spectrum around standing, support, sustenance, and intensive maintenance, while the local base reading still governs the prose.
topics.reason: Accepted variant evidence can show semantic pressure, but it should not replace the local form with every variant shade.

topics.headline: support phrase points toward closure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the support-for-people phrase as both a hinge toward universal divine knowledge and an audible pairing of support noun with human beneficiaries.
topics.reason: The trajectory and cadence rows add local structural payoff without overriding lexical sense.

words.gloss_range: for people as beneficiaries of the support system
words.root_gloss_range: human sociality and humankind; locally the comprehensive beneficiary class

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: for people as beneficiaries of the support system

words.prose: {{ar:لِلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:li-n-nāsi}}) makes people the beneficiaries of the support system, not just observers of it. The phrase gives the institution universal human scope, while sociality and forgetfulness traditions help explain why visible supports teach; the fused surface keeps beneficiary marker and people-term tightly joined, and 2:125 and 3:96 echo the sanctuary-for-people pattern.

topics.headline: people as universal beneficiaries
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the support system is for people as such, not only for a narrow ritual subset.
topics.reason: The preposition marks beneficiary and the definite collective noun supplies broad human scope.

topics.headline: human sociality and need for visible institutions
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the beneficiary term carries sociality and forgetfulness pressure, while the fused surface still only marks the people as beneficiaries.
topics.reason: The etymological dispute is useful as pressure but is kept subordinate to the prepositional phrase.

topics.headline: sanctuary-for-people formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the phrase as part of a sanctuary-for-people pattern also visible in 2:125 and 3:96.
topics.reason: The formulaic echo is concrete and compatible with the local beneficiary phrase.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction that expands the object list

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction that expands the object list

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) expands the governed object list by bringing the sacred month under the same making-and-support frame as the House. With its later repetitions, the one-letter connector helps coordinate the month, offerings, and garlands as cumulative objects sharing the same support predicate.

topics.headline: conjunction expands the governed list
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sacred month, and through repeated conjunctions the offerings and garlands, are pulled under the same making-and-support governance as the House.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the next object with the prior object complex rather than opening a new clause.

words.gloss_range: the sacred month as a recognized time institution
words.root_gloss_range: visibility, public announcement, and lunar month; locally public sacred time

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the sacred month as a recognized time institution

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلشَّهْرَ}} ({{tr:al-shahra}}) is not background time; it is a coordinated object made part of the support system. Its visibility and lunar-public marking make sacred order legible as calendar time, the assimilated article audibly tightens its legal identity, and 5:2 supplies the same protected-marker context.

topics.headline: sacred month as made support item
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that sacred time is itself an instituted support, not background chronology.
topics.reason: The accusative coordinated-object role places the month inside the same made support system.

topics.headline: public visibility of lunar time
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the month supports people by making sacred order publicly visible in time, with the assimilated article audibly tightening its legal identity.
topics.reason: The root field of public visibility and the recognized legal time marker fit the local noun.

words.gloss_range: inviolable sacredness qualifying the month
words.root_gloss_range: prohibition, sacrality, and protected boundary; locally temporal inviolability

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: inviolable sacredness qualifying the month

words.prose: The second {{ar:ٱلْحَرَامَ}} ({{tr:al-ḥarāma}}) transfers inviolability from House to month. The ayah therefore makes sacred place and sacred time parallel supports rather than separate religious categories.

topics.headline: protected sacred time mirrors protected space
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same inviolability used for the House is applied to time, making sacred space and sacred time parallel supports.
topics.reason: The repeated modifier and root handoff support a domain shift from place to month.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction adding the offerings

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction adding the offerings

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds the offering animals without breaking the institutional series. The ritual object that follows is included under the same divine making and support relation.

topics.headline: conjunction adds offerings to the system
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that offerings enter the same governed list rather than standing as a side note.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates the offering noun with the previous objects of the opening verb.

words.gloss_range: recognized sacrificial offerings led toward the sanctuary
words.root_gloss_range: guiding, directing, gifting, and offering; locally the offering-animal institution

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: recognized sacrificial offerings led toward the sanctuary

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْهَدْىَ}} ({{tr:al-hadya}}) is a recognized offering class within the made support system. Its root range lets the sacrifice appear as guided, gifted movement toward the sanctuary, so the offering is oriented dedication rather than mere killing.

topics.headline: offering animals as instituted support
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the offerings are a recognized ritual class within the support system, not an incidental sacrifice detail.
topics.reason: Definiteness, collective shape, and coordination under the opening verb all support the institutional reading.

topics.headline: guided and gifted dedication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the offering as directed movement toward the sanctuary, so sacrifice becomes oriented dedication rather than mere killing.
topics.reason: The root range of guidance, gifting, and leading is locally appropriate for offerings led to the sanctuary.

words.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction adding the garlands

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: coordinating conjunction adding the garlands

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) brings the garlands in as the list’s final visible marker. One knowledge-formula comparison attached here is only ledger material for this word, because its payoff belongs with the later closing clause.

topics.headline: final conjunction culminates the visible marker list
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the garlands arriving as the culminating visible sign in the same sacred-institution sequence.
topics.reason: The repeated conjunction keeps the final item in the cumulative object list.

topics.headline: knowledge-formula row belongs elsewhere
topics.no_reader_payoff_reason: The concrete payoff is handled under the later knowledge-clause words, so this row adds no reader-facing value for this conjunction.
topics.reason: The 5:40 knowledge-formula comparison concerns the closing knowledge clause, not the conjunction before the garlands.

words.gloss_range: garlands as visible protected markers on offerings
words.root_gloss_range: encircling, hanging, designating, and key-like access imagery; locally ritual garlands

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: garlands as visible protected markers on offerings

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْقَلَٰٓئِدَ}} ({{tr:al-qalāʾida}}) makes protection visible on the offering animals through garlands, and the internal hamza makes the marker-word acoustically conspicuous at the list’s end. The root’s encircling and key-related range resonates with cosmic keys in 39:63 and 42:12, but the local word remains ritual garlands; the same marker pair in 5:2 and 5:97 makes prohibition and explanation answer each other.

topics.headline: garlands as protected visible markers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the garlands make protection visible on the bodies of the offering animals and acoustically conspicuous at the end of the list.
topics.reason: The noun is a definite coordinated object, and the plural marker class distributes one sign-function across many offerings.

topics.headline: encircling marker and key motif
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a root-level relation between ritual neck-markers and cosmic keys in 39:63 and 42:12, while the local word still means garlands.
topics.reason: The rare root distribution supports the echo, but the local object remains the sacrificial garlands, not keys.

topics.headline: same-surah protected-marker return
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the garlands prohibited from violation in 5:2 are explained in 5:97 as part of the support system.
topics.reason: The same-surah pair and rarity evidence reinforce the local list relation.

words.gloss_range: demonstrative reference to the whole preceding system
words.root_gloss_range: demonstrative pointing; locally a backward-pointing pivot into purpose

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: demonstrative reference to the whole preceding system

words.prose: {{ar:ذَٰلِكَ}} ({{tr:dhālika}}) gathers the whole preceding sequence into one inspectable sign. It pivots the ayah from enumeration to purpose, making the reader look back at the institutions before hearing what they are meant to teach.

topics.headline: that gathers the whole system
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one demonstrative compressing House, month, offerings, and garlands into a single inspectable system.
topics.reason: The demonstrative points back to the entire list and treats it as one referential unit.

topics.headline: pivot from enumeration to explanation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah pause after the concrete institutions before revealing what they are meant to teach.
topics.reason: The discourse trajectory moves from concrete supports to the purpose clause.

words.gloss_range: purpose clause: so the addressed people come to know
words.root_gloss_range: knowing, recognizing, and knowledge; locally human learning as intended outcome

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: purpose clause: so the addressed people come to know

words.prose: {{ar:لِتَعْلَمُوا}} ({{tr:li-taʿlamū}}) states the purpose: the tangible system exists so the addressed people come to know. The word begins the knowledge cascade that moves from human learning to divine knowing and finally to the knowledge attribute, with the second-person learners carried into the imperative to know in 5:98.

topics.headline: human knowing as intended outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the institutions are not only regulated objects; they are arranged so people come to know.
topics.reason: The purpose prefix with subjunctive verb makes human knowledge the telos of the preceding system.

topics.headline: knowledge cascade from humans to divine attribute
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees legal-sacred vocabulary interlock with a three-step knowledge movement: human learning, divine knowing, and the final attribute.
topics.reason: The repeated knowledge root across the ayah supports the purpose-to-attribute trajectory.

topics.headline: addressed learners continue into 5:98
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the second-person learners here are carried into the imperative to know in 5:98.
topics.reason: The forward link is concrete and compatible with the local second-person form.

words.gloss_range: complementizer that fixes the content of what is to be known

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: complementizer that fixes the content of what is to be known

words.prose: {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}) turns that purpose into determinate content rather than vague awareness. It opens the first proposition and prepares for a second matching content clause later in the ayah.

topics.headline: content clause makes knowledge determinate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the required knowledge is a specific proposition, not vague awareness.
topics.reason: The complementizer opens the content clause governed by the purpose verb.

topics.headline: first of two content clauses
topics.reader_payoff: The reader anticipates that the first knowledge content will be paired with a second proposition.
topics.reason: The later matching complementizer confirms the paired clause structure.

words.gloss_range: the divine name as subject of the first knowledge proposition
words.root_gloss_range: divinity and worship; locally the subject inside the content clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the divine name as subject of the first knowledge proposition

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) is the subject inside the first content proposition. The one people are to know about is the same divine agent who made the institutions a support system.

topics.headline: divine name as subject of first proposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that what people are to know is centered on the same divine agent who founded the institutions.
topics.reason: The accusative subject role inside the content clause reconnects the purpose clause to the opening agent.

words.gloss_range: ongoing divine knowing governing the cosmic object span
words.root_gloss_range: knowing and knowledge; locally active continuous knowing

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: ongoing divine knowing governing the cosmic object span

words.prose: {{ar:يَعْلَمُ}} ({{tr:yaʿlamu}}) presents divine knowing as continuous active knowledge. Its object span reaches everything in the heavens and everything in the earth, turning human learning into recognition of divine knowing.

topics.headline: ongoing active divine knowing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices divine knowing as active and continuous, not a past-tense reason that has lapsed.
topics.reason: The imperfect verb form supports continuous active knowing.

topics.headline: knowledge governs the cosmic span
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the knowing verb stretch over everything in the heavens and everything in the earth.
topics.reason: The verb governs the paired relative object spans that follow.

topics.headline: human learning turns to divine knowing
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shift from humans coming to know to the divine act of knowing.
topics.reason: The repeated knowledge root and clause transition support this hinge.

words.gloss_range: unrestricted relative object opening the first known domain

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: unrestricted relative object opening the first known domain

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) opens an unrestricted object domain for that knowing. The contents are left unspecified so the scope remains maximally open before the heavens locate the first domain.

topics.headline: whatever opens the first object domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the object of divine knowing is left maximally open before being located in the heavens.
topics.reason: The relative pronoun functions as the object of the knowing verb and leaves the contents unspecified.

words.gloss_range: locative preposition placing the object within the heavens

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: locative preposition placing the object within the heavens

words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) locates the first open object-domain inside the heavens. Its repetition later creates the balanced container structure of the cosmic pair.

topics.headline: in locates the first totality in the heavens
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the first domain as a container for the unrestricted contents Allah knows.
topics.reason: The locative preposition and its later repetition organize the paired cosmic domains.

words.gloss_range: the heavens as the upper domain in the knowledge span
words.root_gloss_range: height, elevation, and upper realm; locally the definite plural heavens

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the heavens as the upper domain in the knowledge span

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ}} ({{tr:al-samāwāti}}) gives the knowledge claim its full elevated upper domain. As the first half of the heavens-earth pair, it expands the ayah from sanctuary institutions toward cosmic totality.

topics.headline: definite plural upper domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the knowledge claim opening upward into the full elevated domain of the heavens.
topics.reason: The genitive object of the preposition and definite plural form support the upper-domain reading.

topics.headline: heavens-earth merism begins cosmic expansion
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the close expand from local sanctuary institutions into the familiar heavens-earth totality.
topics.reason: The formulaic pair and closure trajectory are compatible with the local noun as first member of the merism.

words.gloss_range: conjunction joining the second relative domain

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: conjunction joining the second relative domain

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) makes the earth-domain clause equal to the heaven-domain clause. The connector keeps both spans governed by the same knowing verb.

topics.headline: conjunction gives earth equal scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the earth-domain clause is coordinated as an equal partner to the heaven-domain clause.
topics.reason: The conjunction joins the two relative-locative spans under the same knowing verb.

words.gloss_range: repeated relative object for the earth-domain clause

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: repeated relative object for the earth-domain clause

words.prose: {{ar:مَا}} ({{tr:mā}}) repeats the open relative object for the earth side. The repeated shape makes the two cosmic domains exhaustive by parallelism.

topics.headline: repeated whatever mirrors the first domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the earth contents receive the same open-ended grammatical shape as the heaven contents.
topics.reason: The repeated relative pronoun creates parallel object slots across the two domains.

words.gloss_range: locative preposition placing the object within the earth

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: locative preposition placing the object within the earth

words.prose: {{ar:فِى}} ({{tr:fī}}) completes the paired locative frame by placing the second open object-domain in the earth. The repetition gives the cosmic pair exact structural balance.

topics.headline: in completes the paired locative frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices exact structural balance as the second preposition locates the open object in the earth.
topics.reason: The repeated preposition completes the paired locative distribution.

words.gloss_range: the earth as the lower domain completing the merism
words.root_gloss_range: earth, ground, and land; locally the lower created domain

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the earth as the lower domain completing the merism

words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَرْضِ}} ({{tr:al-arḍi}}) grounds the knowledge span in the lower created domain. Together with the heavens, it closes the familiar merism as a universal domain claim.

topics.headline: earth grounds the cosmic scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the knowledge span descend into the grounded lower inhabited realm.
topics.reason: The noun is the genitive object of the second locative phrase and carries earth-domain force.

topics.headline: earth completes total created domain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the heavens-earth pair close as a universal domain claim, not as two isolated locations.
topics.reason: The root-pair and formulaic rows support the standard totalizing pair.

words.gloss_range: conjunction adding a second content proposition

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: conjunction adding a second content proposition

words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) adds another content proposition instead of ending with the cosmic contents. The ayah escalates from what is known to the attribute of knowing.

topics.headline: conjunction escalates to another proposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah does not stop at contents known but adds the attribute of knowing itself.
topics.reason: The conjunction coordinates a second content clause with the first.

words.gloss_range: second complementizer introducing the attribute proposition

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: second complementizer introducing the attribute proposition

words.prose: The second {{ar:أَنَّ}} ({{tr:anna}}) introduces the fresh but coordinated proposition. The theology comes in two ordered claims: known contents first, then the all-knowing attribute.

topics.headline: second complementizer generalizes the theology
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices two ordered propositions: known cosmic contents first, then the all-knowing attribute.
topics.reason: The repeated complementizer introduces a fresh but coordinated item of knowledge content.

words.gloss_range: the divine name restated as subject of the final attribute
words.root_gloss_range: divinity and worship; locally the subject of the closing predicate

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: the divine name restated as subject of the final attribute

words.prose: {{ar:ٱللَّهَ}} ({{tr:allāha}}) is restated so the final attribute is explicitly tied to the same divine agent. The ayah’s name pattern sounds like maker, knower, all-knowing.

topics.headline: divine name anchors final attribute
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears a three-beat frame: the maker, the knower, and the one described by the final knowledge attribute.
topics.reason: The divine name is restated as the subject of the final predicate, tying the attribute explicitly to the same agent.

words.gloss_range: with every, binding totality to the final predicate
words.root_gloss_range: totality and entirety; locally exhaustive scope in construct with the thing-word

supporting_anchors.gloss_range: with every, binding totality to the final predicate

words.prose: {{ar:بِكُلِّ}} ({{tr:bi-kulli}}) binds totality to the final predicate. The scope is every possible member, not only the named heavens-earth contents, and 5:17 offers a same-surah contrast where the same total range serves divine power rather than knowledge.

topics.headline: every binds totality to the final predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final attribute is not limited to the named heavens-earth contents but reaches every possible member.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The causative ja'ala, the Ka'bah as the sacred House, the sacred month, and qiyaman li-l-nas.
baseline_models.mechanism: God appoints a fixed refuge, a protected spatial field, and a recurrent protected time to function together as the mainstay of public life. Qiyaman therefore names maintained social order and livelihood, not only the honor of a monument.

activation_trace.role: Causative placement supplies deliberate appointment and assigns the listed institutions their public function.
The elevated square-house image supplies a fixed and conspicuous center for the system.
Shelter and dwelling make the center a refuge that gathers and houses rather than a bare landmark.
Spatial sanctuary and its attached rights create a protected field around the House.
Temporal truce extends the same protection into a recurrent sacred interval.
Mainstay, order, and livelihood give qiyaman its functional force as what keeps collective life standing.

changed_reading.before: The Ka'bah and sacred month are honored observances that benefit people.
changed_reading.after: God's appointment coordinates refuge, protected space, and recurrent truce as infrastructure by which collective life, livelihood, and order remain standing.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sanctuary-bound offering, the garlands, qiyaman, and the purpose clause about learning.
baseline_models.mechanism: Offerings move toward the sanctuary while neck-marks make their destination and protected status publicly readable. Protection therefore travels with marked carriers, routing resources and obligations through space while restraining seizure; this mobile legibility contributes to public support.

activation_trace.role: A gift sent to the sanctuary supplies directed movement of material provision toward the protected center.
A neck-marker used for distinction makes the carrier's protected destination visible in transit.
A distinguishing sign that guides an observer links visible marking to the ayah's movement from institution to knowledge.
Care, preservation, and governance make protected circulation an actively maintained public arrangement.

changed_reading.before: The offerings and garlands are additional sacred objects in the list.
changed_reading.after: They are mobile, visibly marked carriers of sanctuary-bound obligation: protection travels with them, making circulation itself part of the public support system.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence from God's appointment to 'so that you may know,' followed by God's knowledge of the heavens, earth, and every thing.
baseline_models.mechanism: The ayah moves from a bounded and publicly readable order to unbounded divine knowledge. The institution is thus an embodied lesson: humans infer from coordinated signs within their field to the knowledge that comprehends the whole field.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower supplies the explicit human-learning and divine-knowing axis.
The mark that distinguishes and guides lets the appointed order operate as evidence rather than as an unrelated doctrinal preface.
What is above and overarching supplies the upper reach of the total field known by God.
The lower field opposite the sky completes the vertical span of the claim.
Comprehensiveness and completion prevent the knowledge claim from being restricted to the sacred system alone.
Anything knowable or reportable supplies the unrestricted object of divine knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The institutions are followed by a doctrinal assertion that God knows everything.
changed_reading.after: The appointed institution is itself an embodied lesson: a bounded order humans can read becomes evidence pointing from local coordination to God's exhaustive knowledge of the whole.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding sequence exposes appetites that dissolve attention and social bonds, then makes reachable game a revealing test. An intentional breach is not left as raw exclusion: judgment converts it into equivalent compensation, including an offering that reaches the Ka'bah. The focus's qiyaman is thereby revised into a resilient boundary-and-repair system.

activation_trace.role: A drink that covers the intellect supplies a counter-mechanism that disables the discernment and restraint public order needs.
Testing that makes a condition appear turns nearby prey into a disclosure of otherwise hidden restraint.
The second mapped inventory likewise supplies trial as a means by which the actor's state becomes manifest.
Deliberate intention differentiates accountable breach from mere contact with the boundary.
Answering an act with its consequence supplies the conversion from violation into reparative obligation.
Equivalence and balancing make compensation proportionate rather than arbitrary.
The sanctuary-bound offering routes the repaired obligation into the same material channel named in the focus ayah.
The fixed sacred House is the destination that closes the reparative route.

structural_cues: 5:87-93 calibrates permission, self-restraint, oath repair, and practices that generate enmity rather than support.
5:94 makes reachable game a test whose result is concealed fear or transgression.
5:95 routes intentional breach through judged equivalence, offering, food, or fasting, while 5:96 redraws the land and sea boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appetite, revealed testing, intentional breach, equivalent compensation, and an offering reaching the Ka'bah. I infer that qiyaman names a resilient boundary-and-repair system, not only a protected monument; the live alternative is that these rules merely exemplify obedience without defining the focus ayah's public-support mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The sacred complex supports people chiefly by forbidding violence and protecting a center.
changed_reading.after: It supports people by calibrating access, testing restraint, and converting intentional breach into proportionate, sanctuary-routed repair.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately after the focus, divine knowledge covers both disclosure and concealment, while human judgment is told not to equate bad with good when numerical abundance attracts. The purpose 'so that you may know' is sharpened into trained discrimination: public signs sustain only when their quality is read correctly rather than counted or admired.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge as disclosure continues the focus ayah's explicit knowing axis into what people reveal and conceal.
Hiding and covering supplies the unseen side that human public markers cannot exhaust.
Comparison and equivalence are explicitly refused, making discernment a judgment of kind rather than a neutral tally.
Badness opposed to the good supplies the qualitative distinction that the knower must preserve.
Growth in number supplies the attractive but epistemically insufficient signal.

structural_cues: 5:98 commands knowledge of paired severity and forgiveness.
5:99 contrasts the messenger's delivery with God's knowledge of what is disclosed and concealed.
5:100 denies equivalence between bad and good even when the bad's abundance attracts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hidden versus disclosed conduct and quality versus quantity. I infer that the focus institution trains calibrated discernment by making consequential distinctions public; the live alternative is that 5:100 is only a general moral maxim with no institutional feedback into qiyaman.

changed_reading.before: Learning from the sacred complex means recognizing that God knows all things.
changed_reading.after: Learning from it also means acquiring a public discipline of distinction that resists concealment, false equivalence, and the glamour of abundance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact divine-appointment construction returns under negation for named animal taboos, which are attributed instead to falsehood and inherited nonknowledge. This makes authorization constitutive: a visible restriction or marked animal does not become socially sustaining merely by resembling the focus ayah's sacred forms.

activation_trace.role: Causative appointment reappears under explicit negation, creating a direct foil to God's positive appointment in the focus ayah.
Contradiction of truth supplies the mechanism by which customary sacrality is falsely attributed to God.
Absent knowledge exposes inherited sufficiency as an unreliable basis for sacred classification.
Failure to find and follow the right way contrasts fabricated custom with the focus ayah's directed sanctuary order.

structural_cues: 5:101-102 warns that demands for additional disclosed rules can become burdens and then grounds for rejection.
5:103 uses 'God did not appoint' to negate four customary animal designations.
5:104 contrasts inherited sufficiency with ancestors who possessed neither knowledge nor guidance.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a verbal negative foil to ja'ala Allah and links the rejected designations to falsehood, ignorance, and failed guidance. I infer that divine authorization is part of what lets the focus system be qiyaman; the live alternative is a narrower rejection of four customs without a general authorization criterion.

changed_reading.before: Sacred status appears to reside in marked objects and restrictions themselves.
changed_reading.after: The sanctuary, month, offerings, and garlands sustain because God appoints and directs them; analogous markings and restrictions fabricated through custom are counter-institutions, not qiyam.

context_deltas.mechanism: The testimony sequence gives limited human knowledge a public procedure: witnessed claims can be tested, displaced witnesses can be replaced, and oaths can be returned. The following gathering of messengers ends in confessed human nonknowledge before the knower of the unseen. The focus's local signs therefore model accountable knowledge under, but never equal to, divine omniscience.

activation_trace.role: A declaration grounded in knowledge supplies the human evidentiary unit that must be made public and reviewable.
Standing in another's place supplies procedural substitution when the first testimony fails.
Returning a claim to its prior side supplies reversible review rather than irreversible assertion.
The contrast between denied creaturely knowledge and intensified divine knowing fixes the asymmetry of the epistemic system.
What is screened from eyes supplies the domain that public witnessing cannot independently master.

structural_cues: 5:106 establishes paired witnesses, oath, suspicion, and the prohibition on concealing testimony.
5:107-108 responds to discovered fault with replacement witnesses and the prospect of returned oaths.
5:109 gathers the messengers, who disclaim knowledge before God's knowledge of hidden realities.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies revisable testimony, role substitution, returned oaths, creaturely nonknowledge, and divine knowledge of the unseen. I infer a two-tier epistemology in which qiyaman includes procedures for acting responsibly under partial knowledge; the live alternative is that the legal procedure and the focus's cosmic knowledge claim remain parallel but unintegrated.

changed_reading.before: The focus contrasts ordinary human learning with God's unlimited knowledge.
changed_reading.after: It also implies an institutional answer to that asymmetry: humans keep society standing through visible, revisable evidence while total hidden knowledge remains God's alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The table sequence joins descent from the sky, food, settled hearts, knowledge, witness, recurrent feast, visible sign, and apportioned provision. It activates the focus list as a distributed public table: House, month, offering, and marker coordinate recurring provision so that material participation becomes reassurance and knowledge.

activation_trace.role: A food-bearing table supplies the concrete provisioning surface around which the later sequence gathers.
The overarching sky supplies the source domain that links material provision back to the focus's heaven-and-earth knowledge span.
Settling and reassurance make eating functional evidence for the participants rather than consumption alone.
Knowledge arising in the sequence directly activates the focus purpose clause.
A feast defined by recurrence supplies the periodic social form that resonates with the sacred month.
The alternate mapped image of counted returning time strengthens the link between recurrence and calendrical support.
A manifest sign turns the provision into publicly apprehensible evidence.
Apportioned giving supplies the material distribution that lets a recurring sign sustain a community.

structural_cues: 5:112-113 moves from requested descent and eating to settled hearts, knowledge, and witness.
5:114 names the table a recurring feast for first and last, a sign, and provision.
5:115 makes rejection after the disclosed sign more accountable, preserving the link between evidence and response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the sequence food to reassurance to knowledge to witness, then feast to sign to provision. I infer an analogy in which the focus complex distributes those functions across place, time, offerings, and marks; the live alternative is that the table episode is only another sign narrative and should not reshape the focus list as a provisioning table.

changed_reading.before: The House, month, offerings, and garlands are separate supports assembled in one list.
changed_reading.after: Together they can be read as a recurring public table: a coordinated provisioning cycle whose material participation steadies people and teaches through a visible sign.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pericope closes by repeating the focus's heavens, earth, every, and thing while adding divine sovereignty and capacity. This exact lexical return scales the reading: the sanctuary order is a local, inspectable instance nested within universal ownership and effective power.

activation_trace.role: Sovereignty supplies the governing relation under which the focus's local appointment operates.
The repeated upper domain begins the exact cosmic span already used in the focus.
The repeated lower domain completes the same heaven-and-earth field.
Comprehensive totality repeats the focus's refusal of any excluded remainder.
The unrestricted knowable thing repeats the object range of the focus claim.
Effective capacity supplies the ability to enact and sustain the universal order, not knowledge alone.

structural_cues: 5:120 repeats the focus collocation of heavens, earth, every, and thing.
The closing verse changes the predicate from exhaustive knowledge to sovereignty and effective capacity.
5:116-119 has already staged the judgment of human claims before this universal closing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an exact lexical echo plus sovereignty and capacity. I infer that the focus complex is a finite governance model nested under the order of the whole; the live alternative is that 5:120 is only a closing doxology and the echo does not feed back into qiyaman.

changed_reading.before: The sacred complex is local evidence that God knows the entire cosmos.
changed_reading.after: It is a local order nested within God's ownership and effective governance of the entire cosmos, a model of rule rather than a support that itself bears the universe.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates form-distant material images in Ka'bah and garlands. It remains anchored in the focus words and gains contextual support from tied obligations and substitute standing; downstream prose should present it only as a secondary structural analogy, never as a lexical replacement for the Ka'bah or qiyaman.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Ka'bah as a joint, garlands as twisted binding, and qiyaman as a system in which one element can hold or stand for another.

activation_trace.role: A joint between segments supplies the material analogy of a center that couples otherwise separate routes and obligations.
Twisting one element around another supplies binding as the mobile counterpart to the central joint.
Tying ends together gives the analogy a social and obligational realization in contracted oaths.
Standing in another's place shows the order preserving continuity by coupling roles through substitution.

changed_reading.before: The Ka'bah is the central destination of a protected sacred network.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it is also the network's social joint: obligations, marked carriers, times, and substitute roles are bound through a center so the whole can keep standing.

strongest_changes: The hunting sequence revises qiyaman from static protection into calibrated boundary, test, and proportionate repair.
The negated appointment of customary animal taboos makes divine authorization constitutive and exposes counterfeit sacred institutions.
The testimony sequence turns the knowledge claim into a two-tier epistemology of revisable human evidence under divine knowledge of the unseen.
The closing heaven-and-earth echo places the local sanctuary order under universal sovereignty and effective capacity.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly reactivated the focus's own operators rather than merely adding themes: appointment is negated in counterfeit sacrality, standing becomes procedural substitution, knowledge is tested through witnesses and signs, and the cosmic formula returns under sovereignty. The table sequence additionally joined provision, recurrence, reassurance, and knowledge into a live cross-domain model.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the recurring-table model is a governing contextual mechanism or a strong but local analogy.
How much weight the material joint-and-binding outlier should receive beyond exploratory prose.
Whether qiyaman primarily names livelihood and public order or also carries a stronger governance sense in this context.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin baskın çekirdeği bir işi, topluluğu ya da düzeni sürekli gözetmek, korumak ve yönetmektir. Aynı ifadede bir işi üstlenmeye değinen unsur önceki niyet dalıyla örtüştüğünden, burada ancak sürekli sorumluluk ve koruma doğurduğu ölçüde kullanılmalıdır.

branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه آنس الشيء إذا أبصره أو رآه، وآنس الصوت إذا سمعه، وأحس الفزع أو وجد الشيء في نفسه، والاستئناس بمعنى النظر والتبصر.
يدخل فيه أنس الإنسان بالشيء أو بفلان، المؤانسة والتأنيس، الأنيس وكل ما يؤنس به، الفرح بالقرب والحديث، والحيوان الأنوس غير العقور.
يدخل فيه إنسي الدابة والقوس وكل شيئين: ما يلي الإنسان أو يقبل على الراكب أو الرامي، في مقابلة الوحشي.

يدخل فيه كيف ابن إنسك للسؤال عن النفس، وفلان ابن أنس فلان لصفيه وخاصته، وما قاربه من الخدن والأنيس والخلص والجليس.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak anlatımı bir işi ya da sorumluluğu kişinin üzerine yükleme, kişinin bunu üstlenmesi, yöneticilere görev verme ve inanç alanında bir tutuma bağlanma kullanımlarını aynı yükümlülük çekirdeğinde birleştirir. lexicalization_scope.note: Anlam yalnızca iş, sorumluluk, yöneticilik veya inanç bağlılığı kuran söz birliklerine bağlıdır; yalın köke genel bir zorunluluk anlamı verilmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli söz kalıplarında bir işi ya da sorumluluğu birine vermek veya kişinin bunu kendi üzerine almasıdır. İnanç alanındaki kullanım, bir görüşü benimseyip ona bağlı kalmayı anlatır.

facets.statement: Bir iş veya sorumluluk kişiye yüklenir ya da kişi onu kendi üzerine alır.

İnanç konusunda bir görüşü benimseyip izleme, üstlenme ve bağlı kalma ilişkisinin düşünce alanına genişlemesidir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Dalın bilme ve bilgisizliğin karşıtı olma yönündeki çekirdeği kaynak ifadesiyle uyumludur. Ancak haberden haberdar olma, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi bakımından üstün gelme kullanımları bu çekirdekle aynı düzeyde değil, belirli biçimlere bağlı uzantılar olarak tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım çıplak bilme çekirdeğini öne alır; haber, öğretim, öğrenim ve karşılıklı bilgi sınamasıyla ilgili anlamları yalnızca ilgili biçim ve kuruluşlara bağlar.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi bilmek, tanımak ve onu gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavramak; böylece bilgisizlikten çıkmaktır. Haber verilmesi, öğretme, öğrenme ve bilgi bakımından üstün gelme bu çekirdekten hareket eden, belirli biçimlere bağlı kullanımlardır.

facets.statement: Bir şeyi bilme, tanıma ve gerçeğine uygun biçimde kavrama durumu bilgisizliğin karşıtıdır.
Bir haberin farkına varmak veya ondan haberdar olmak, bilme çekirdeğinin belirli bir konuya uygulanmasıdır.
Bildirme, öğretme ve öğrenme biçimleri bilginin bir başkasına ulaştırılması ya da kişinin onu edinmesi süreçlerini anlatır.
Karşılıklı bilgi sınamasında birini yenmek, belirli bir kuruluşta ortaya çıkan rekabetçi kullanımdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği, bilgiyi bilgisizliğin karşıtı sayar ve bir şeyi tanıyıp gerçeğiyle kavramayı öne çıkarır. Toplu tanıklık ayrıca haberden haberdar olmayı, bilgiyi aktarmayı, öğrenmeyi ve bilgiyle üstün gelmeyi biçime bağlı uzantılar olarak gösterir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir şeyi başkasından ayıran belirgin izi dalın ortak çekirdeği olarak açıkça destekler. Bayrak, belirgin dağ, yol belirtisi, kumaş deseni ve savaş işareti gibi örnekler bu çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir; tanınmış kişi ve son zaman belirtisi ise benzetme veya gösterme ilişkisine bağlı uzantılardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Ayırt edici iz çıplak çekirdektir; savaşçı, kumaş, sarık ve belirli zaman göstergesiyle kurulan anlamlar kendi kuruluşlarına bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi başkalarından ayıran, tanınmasını sağlayan veya ona götüren belirgin iz ya da işarettir. Bayrak, uzaktan seçilen dağ, yol belirtisi, kumaş kenarı ve sonradan konan tanıtıcı izler bu işlevin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.

facets.statement: Bir nesneyi veya kişiyi başkalarından ayırıp tanınır kılan belirgin iz ya da işaret çekirdeği oluşturur.
Bayrak, belirgin dağ, yol belirtisi ve kumaşın kenar deseni yön bulduran veya tanıtan somut gerçekleşmelerdir.
Savaşçının, kumaşın veya sarığın ayırt edici bir işaretle donatılması belirli kuruluşlara bağlı eylemsel kullanımdır.
Tanınmış bir kişinin belirgin bir bayrağa benzetilmesi ve yaklaşan son zamanı gösteren belirti, işaret çekirdeğinin uzantılarıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ayırt edici izi ortak temel sayar ve bayrak, yüksek ya da belirgin dağ, yol göstergesi, kumaş kenarı, kına ve sonradan yerleştirilen tanıtıcı işaretleri bu temelde toplar. Tanınmış kişi ile yaklaşan son zamanın belirtisi de görünürlük ve gösterme işlevinden doğan uzantılardır.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin üzerinde bulunan ve onu örten gök, tavan ya da genel üst yandır. Bu ad buluta, yukarıdan gelen yağmura, yağmurla çıkan veya yükselen bitkiye ve atın sırtına da aktarılır.

root_profile.summary: Bu kök, körelip güçten düşme, başkasına yük olma, eksiksiz kapsam, yan kol mirasçılığı, çevreleyen taç ve bulut görünümleri, koruyucu örtü, göğüs, kısa kalın beden, topluluklar, saldırıda ilerleme veya geri durma ve diş gösteren gülümsemeyi ayrı dallarda toplar. Bazı dallar çevreleme ya da görünüş benzerliğiyle içten bağlantılı olsa da bütün yapı belirgin ölçüde eşsesli ve çok anlamlıdır.
